changed_axis.name: txgraffiti_relation_geometry
changed_axis.justification: TF4-DIAG-0001 found 8/12 TF3 ratios exactly overlapped TF2, 9/12 had discovery touch count 1, and 8/12 extremal coefficients drifted by exposed order 13. Fixed pairwise hulls produced 146 exact-deduplicated low-dimensional forms, 127 with exactly two RHS features, only 5 exact TF2 overlaps, median denominator 4, and 32 forms that are both K1-valid and stable across burned orders 11-13. This is the minimal controlled interaction increase supported by the completed TF3 failure mode.

txgraffiti.adapter_semantics: TreeForge empty hypothesis payload is normalized to upstream None (always-true base predicate)
txgraffiti.feature_set_construction: Run once for each of the 21 unordered pairs of the seven discovery features, in combinations(discovery_features, 2) order.
txgraffiti.cross_run_processing: Exact normalized (lhs, operator, rhs) deduplication only; preserve every source feature pair for provenance.

interpretability_policy.violation_policy: Abort if a final cross-run-deduplicated statement uses a symbol outside the seven frozen discovery features, uses more than two RHS discovery features, or otherwise violates the frozen pairwise grammar. Do not silently filter or retune it.

literal_domain_consistency_gate.timing: After permanent IDs are allocated to every cross-run exact-deduplicated final statement and after exact discovery-side reevaluation, but before candidate_batch.json is frozen and before any order-14 holdout construction.
literal_domain_consistency_gate.action: Any otherwise-CONJECTURED statement false on K1 is permanently classified FALSIFIED with K1 as exposed domain-consistency evidence.
literal_domain_consistency_gate.rationale: Discovery starts at order 2 although the literal statement includes K1. TF4 retains the all-tree hypothesis and closes that lifecycle mismatch without using fresh validation data.

candidate_policy.normalization: Use structured TxGraffiti lhs/operator/rhs metadata; preserve raw per-pair statements and source feature pairs; no post-hoc coefficient tuning.
candidate_policy.duplicate_equivalence: Exact normalized (lhs, operator, rhs) equality across pairwise runs.
candidate_policy.batch_freeze: All discovery-side machine triage plus the exposed K1 domain-consistency gate must finish and candidate_batch.json plus its SHA-256 must be written before any fresh order-14 holdout construction.

exposed_data.orders_1_to_13: All orders 1-13 are burned/exposed for TF4. Orders 2-10 remain the discovery corpus; K1 and orders 11-13 are diagnosis/domain-check material only.
exposed_data.policy: Exposed data may be used for diagnosis, domain consistency, or regression checks but never counted as TF4 fresh validation evidence.

fresh_holdout_firewall.feasibility_probe: TF4-DIAG-0001 run 36972524602 timed all order-14 generation and the two expensive exact invariants. Individual order-14 invariant values were not persisted, printed, ranked, or compared with any candidate.

anti_numerology: exact discovery-side reevaluation of every machine statement
exact normalized cross-run duplicate detection before candidate-batch freeze
literal all-tree K1 domain-consistency check before candidate-batch freeze
pairwise RHS grammar assertion before candidate-batch freeze
holdout_policy: All unlabeled trees of order 14 are the fresh exhaustive TF4 holdout. Orders 1-13 are excluded as burned/exposed. The holdout is not constructed by the scientific runner until permanent IDs, discovery-side triage, the exposed K1 domain-consistency gate, and candidate-batch persistence are complete.
adversarial_policy: Only fresh order-14 holdout survivors see the exact pre-frozen TF4 adversarial instances. Exact TF2/TF3 hostile trees and all previously inspected structures are regression-only, not fresh evidence.
source_commit_policy: The exact commit used by a future scientific run must be recorded in its manifest and experiment registry record. Corpus hashes that include source-commit labels are recorded by that run.
mutation_policy: Any material post-output change to target, features, discovery split, holdout, pairwise feature-set construction, TxGraffiti method set, heuristics, post-processors, hypothesis semantics, literal-domain gate, interpretability policy, candidate normalization, or fresh adversarial set closes TF4-0001 and requires a new experiment ID.
fresh_adversarial_identity: Exact cross-order tree identity is the pair (order, canonical_tree_code). The legacy bare code is preserved for historical hashes and is only complete within a fixed order.
